title: [FOSSi Dial-Up] Tim Ansell - Skywater PDK: Fully open source manufacturable PDK for a 130nm process
summary: Tim Ansell presents the SkyWater PDK, a fully open source manufacturable process development kit for a 130nm process, as the first FOSSi Dial-Up talk. He covers its role in a fully open chip design flow.
why: HN commenters point to it for Google's reasons for backing open silicon and for background on the open-source chip design workflow.

quote.text: I suggest you watch this video from Google where they explain why they are doing what they are doing
